name: WildFin Northwest Seafood Chowder Cup (Heavy Cream Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: WildFin American Grill (Mountain View Village · Riverton, UT)
whyItWorks: Classic Pacific Northwest chowder loaded with heavy whipping cream, bacon drippings, butter, clams, and potatoes. Concentrated dairy fat and rubbery clam bits can aggravate active IBD.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dairy & Fat Warning: Savor only small tastes during remission, or swap for a cup of clear broth.
